# Native JSON dependency

nlohmann/json v3.11.3, single header, MIT. No runtime download.
Source: https://github.com/nlohmann/json/tree/v3.11.3
Header SHA-256: `9bea4c8066ef4a1c206b2be5a36302f8926f7fdc6087af5d20b417d0cf103ea6`.
The original notice and LICENSE.MIT are retained in `nlohmann/`.

The file-lock algorithm is independently implemented with reference to the MIT
PowerToys File Locksmith design at commit
`dd65f4017eed298e3e6d898e24fc55f9c224b069`. No PowerToys binary/runtime is included.
Reference: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/tree/dd65f4017eed298e3e6d898e24fc55f9c224b069/src/modules/FileLocksmith
